call_points.text: Aadhaar project: ₹75 Cr invested of about ₹125 Cr; full investment done next quarter, full revenue from Q4.
Digital business won a West Bengal Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY mandate, a Tamil Nadu Grama Bank mandate and a Coverfox partnership.
Capital allocation priority is organic expansion, then M&A, then dividends; M&A investments are generating 17-20% returns.
On buybacks, management said it is not under consideration now but may be discussed at the next Board meeting.
Asked to quantify value created by acquisitions, management deferred the question to the CFO and moved on.
Visa & Consular FY26 EBITDA margin rose to 40.1% from 34.5% on the self-managed model.
UIDAI contract runs six years at 15-20% EBITDA margin, with full revenue at least a year away.
Cash to be used for existing business expansion and inorganic growth in both segments.
Other income was higher by ₹5-6 Cr from a one-off forex gain, not recurring.
Middle East tension: management says some countries saw a drop but annual and quarterly numbers still grew.
Asked for April trends and FY27 revenue numbers, management declined forward-looking comment.

operating_notes.text: FY26 processed 44.1 lakh visa applications, up from 37.5 lakh, with net revenue per application of ₹3,302 versus ₹2,903.
UIDAI/Aadhaar contract worth ₹2,500 Cr runs six years; Phase I of 40-50 offices done, over 200 offices planned.
Digital business operates 155,000+ touch points with around 45,800+ channel partners; BC business GTV above ₹1.1 lakh Cr in FY26 versus ₹87,000+ Cr in FY25.
Visa & Consular contributed close to 90% of consolidated EBITDA in Q1FY27, with segment EBITDA of ₹226 Cr at a 40.3% margin.
Acquisition contributions in Q1FY27: iDATA ₹72.5 Cr revenue, Aadifidelis ₹225 Cr, Citizenship Invest ₹17.5 Cr, Aadhaar ₹17.5 Cr; the U.K. hotel generated about ₹16 Cr.
BC business GTV rose to more than ₹29,500 Cr in Q1FY27 from ₹26,200 Cr in Q1FY26.

timeline.summary: On 20 May 2026 BLS International's Q4/FY26 earnings call guided FY27 growth at 20-25% after FY26 revenue rose 37% to ₹2,998 Cr and net cash stood at ₹1,434 Cr.

On 11 August 2026 BLS International's Q1FY27 call reported record quarterly revenue of ₹891 Cr (up 25%), EBITDA of ₹252 Cr and PAT of ₹202 Cr, with net cash of ₹1,617 Cr and reiterated 15-20% organic growth guidance.
